meta.title: Line-Item Quantity Split: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer on the same Growth tenant.
Perform or inspect the Line-Item Quantity Split action before event creation.
Verify that the split is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer, including recording tenant RBAC configuration if additional roles are intentionally allowed.
Ensure or verify the tenant is on the Growth plan.

plan.title: PR line-item quantity split role restriction

steps.note: Begin the required PR-created event flow.
Use an open purchase request, which is eligible to start an event.
Select a purchase request so its purchase actions become available.
Open the PR item flow before event creation, where the quantity split action would be exercised.
Confirm that the PR line items are present before the role-specific split attempt.

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer and as a Buyer on the same Growth tenant, attempt Line-Item Quantity Split capped at the PR amount before creating an event, and record whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available to the Buyer

steps.note: The catalog has no role-specific login or Line-Item Quantity Split step, so the tester must perform and compare the two role-based outcomes.
Confirm the session remains usable and shows no unrelated application error after the tester's role comparison.
